feedback.rationale: Synthetic example: the brief states that 20 customers are paying pilot customers, while its supplied evidence reports 20 free trials and zero paid commitments.
findings: The claim of 20 paying pilot customers is contradicted by evidence of 20 free trials and zero paid commitments.
comments: Separate free-trial participation from paid adoption; report the paid-customer claim only when supported by evidence.
limitations: Scripted replay does not assess an actual market or contact a real expert.
next_steps: Verify paid commitments before presenting the 20-customer claim as established.
